title: Authorization to confess judgment prohibited.
bodyText: A tenant may not authorize any person to confess judgment on a claim arising out of a rental agreement of any dwelling unit. An authorization in violation of this section is void.
bodyHtml: [§521-34]  Authorization to confess judgment prohibited.  A tenant may not authorize any person to confess judgment on a claim arising out of a rental agreement of any dwelling unit.  An authorization in violation of this section is void. [L 1972, c 132, pt of §1]
